definitions.text_en: one (cardinal numeral 1); single unit or individual
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika unità waħda jew individwu wieħed.

usage_examples.mt: Hemm student wieħed biss fil-klassi dalgħodu.
usage_examples.en: There is only one student in the class this morning.

definitions.text_en: two (cardinal numeral 2); pair of units
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika par jew żewġ unitajiet; jiġi wara l-wieħed u qabel it-tlieta.

usage_examples.mt: Għandi tnejn minn dawk il-kotba fuq l-ixkaffa.
usage_examples.en: I have two of those books on the shelf.

definitions.text_en: three (cardinal numeral 3)
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' tliet unitajiet; jiġi wara t-tnejn u qabel l-erbgħa.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm tlieta min-nies jistennew quddiem il-bieb.
usage_examples.en: There were three people waiting in front of the door.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral tlieta is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form tliet serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali tlieta huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra tliet tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tiegħu. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_en: four (cardinal numeral 4)
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' erba' unitajiet; jiġi wara t-tlieta u qabel il-ħamsa.

usage_examples.mt: Xtara erbgħa minnhom biex iqassamhom lil sħabu.
usage_examples.en: He bought four of them to distribute to his friends.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral erbgħa is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form erba' serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali erbgħa huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra erba' tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tagħha. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_en: five (cardinal numeral 5)
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' ħames unitajiet; jiġi wara l-erbgħa u qabel is-sitta.

usage_examples.mt: Fadal biss ħamsa minnhom fil-kaxxa.
usage_examples.en: Only five of them remain in the box.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral ħamsa is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form ħames serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali ħamsa huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra ħames tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tiegħu. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_en: six (cardinal numeral 6)
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' sitt unitajiet; jiġi wara l-ħamsa u qabel is-sebgħa.

usage_examples.mt: It-tfal kollha kienu sitta b'kollox fil-grupp.
usage_examples.en: The children were six in all in the group.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral sitta is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form sitt serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali sitta huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra sitt tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tagħha. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_en: eight (cardinal numeral 8)
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' tmien unitajiet; jiġi wara s-sebgħa u qabel id-disgħa.

usage_examples.mt: Waslu tmienja minnhom fil-ħin għal-laqgħa.
usage_examples.en: Eight of them arrived on time for the meeting.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral tmienja is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form tmien serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali tmienja huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra tmien tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tagħha. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_en: twenty (cardinal numeral 20)
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika żewġ għaxriet jew 20 unità; jiġi wara d-dsatax u qabel il-wieħed u għoxrin.

usage_examples.mt: Għalaq għoxrin sena nhar il-Ħadd li għadda.
usage_examples.en: He turned twenty years old last Sunday.

definitions.text_en: hundred (cardinal numeral 100); combining form before nouns
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għaxar għaxriet jew 100 unità quddiem nom; forma komposta ta' mija.

usage_examples.mt: Għex aktar minn mitt sena b'saħħa tajba.
usage_examples.en: He lived more than a hundred years in good health.

definitions.text_en: thousand (cardinal numeral 1,000)
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għaxar mijiet jew 1,000 unità.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kuntratt jiswa aktar minn elf ewro.
usage_examples.en: The contract is worth more than a thousand euros.

definitions.text_en: million (cardinal numeral 1,000,000)
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika elf elf jew 1,000,000 unità.

usage_examples.mt: Inġabru aktar minn miljun ewro b'risq dawk fil-bżonn.
usage_examples.en: More than a million euros were collected for those in need.

definitions.text_en: first (ordinal numeral); initial, foremost in order or series
definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni tal-bidu jew li jiġi qabel kull ħaġa oħra f'ordni, grad jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Kien l-ewwel student li wasal fl-iskola dalgħodu.
usage_examples.en: He was the first student who arrived at school this morning.

definitions.text_en: second (ordinal numeral); following the first
definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni li tiġi minnufih wara l-ewwel u qabel it-tielet.

usage_examples.mt: Fit-tieni kapitlu tal-ktieb jiddiskuti t-tibdil fil-klima.
usage_examples.en: In the second chapter of the book he discusses climate change.

definitions.text_en: third (ordinal numeral); following the second
definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni li tiġi minnufih wara t-tieni u qabel ir-raba'.

usage_examples.mt: Daħal fit-tielet post fil-kompetizzjoni nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: He finished in third place in the national competition.

definitions.text_en: half (fraction of one half); equal part of a whole
definitions.text_mt: Frazzjoni u kwantità li tindika parti waħda minn żewġ partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa.

definitions.text_en: middle, midpoint; central point in space or time
definitions.text_mt: Il-punt ċentrali jew il-mument tan-nofs bejn żewġ limiti fi spazju jew fi żmien.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa nofs il-ħobża u ħalla l-kumplament għal għada.
usage_examples.en: He took half of the loaf of bread and left the rest for tomorrow.

definitions.text_en: two (short attributive form used directly before nouns)
definitions.text_mt: Forma qasira tal-kardinal tnejn li tintuża direttament qabel nom biex tiddetermina kwantità doppja.

usage_examples.mt: Qiegħed żewġ kotba fuq il-mejda biex jaqrahom aktar tard.
usage_examples.en: He placed two books on the table to read them later.

definitions.text_en: double, twofold; consisting of twice the standard quantity or two matching parts
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur li jindika ammont darbtejn akbar minn dak ordinarju jew magħmul minn żewġ partijiet indaqs.

usage_examples.mt: Ħallas prezz doppju minħabba d-domanda kbira li kien hemm.
usage_examples.en: He paid double the price due to the high demand there was.

definitions.text_en: doubled, twofold; repeated or consisting of two folded or multiplied parts
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur u parteċipju li jindika ammont irduppjat jew magħmul minn żewġ partijiet imtewma.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa sehem bi sforz mtenna biex jirbaħ il-kompetizzjoni.
usage_examples.en: He took part with a redoubled effort to win the competition.

definitions.text_en: third (fraction of one third); one of three equal parts of a divided unit
definitions.text_mt: Frazzjoni li tindika parti waħda minn tliet partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Terz mill-popolazzjoni attendiet għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: A third of the population attended the national celebration.

definitions.text_en: triple, threefold; three times as great or consisting of three parts
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur li jindika ammont tliet darbiet akbar minn dak bażiku jew magħmul minn tliet partijiet.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa sehem f'investiment li ġablu qligħ triplu fl-aħħar tas-sena.
usage_examples.en: He took part in an investment that brought him triple profit at the end of the year.

definitions.text_en: tripled, threefold; multiplied by three or having three parts
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur li jindika ammont immultiplikat bi tlieta jew magħmul minn tliet partijiet.

usage_examples.mt: L-art kellha qsim mtellet f'diversi biċċiet indaqs.
usage_examples.en: The land had a threefold division into several equal pieces.

definitions.text_en: fourth (ordinal numeral); coming next after the third in order or rank
definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni li tiġi minnufih wara t-tielet f'ordni, grad jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Kien ir-raba' wieħed li daħal fil-kamra tal-laqgħat.
usage_examples.en: He was the fourth one who entered the meeting room.

definitions.text_en: quarter (fraction of one fourth); fourth part of a whole, of an hour, or of a standard measure
definitions.text_mt: Frazzjoni li tindika parti waħda minn erba' partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa, jew medda ta' ħmistax-il minuta.

usage_examples.mt: Għadda kwart ta' siegħa minn meta telaq il-vapur.
usage_examples.en: A quarter of an hour has passed since the ship departed.

definitions.text_en: quarter (Semitic fractional form of one fourth); traditional fourth measure
definitions.text_mt: Frazzjoni Semitika li tindika parti waħda minn erba' partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa jew kejl tradizzjonali.

usage_examples.mt: Ħalla robu' mill-qamħ merfugħ fil-maħżen għaż-żerriegħa.
usage_examples.en: He left a quarter of the grain stored in the warehouse for seed.

definitions.text_en: quadruple, fourfold; four times as great in quantity or size
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur li jindika ammont erba' darbiet akbar minn dak ordinarju.

usage_examples.mt: Irreġistraw produzzjoni kwadrupla meta mqabbla mas-sena ta' qabel.
usage_examples.en: They recorded quadruple production compared to the previous year.

definitions.text_en: squared, fourfold; multiplied by four or having four equal sides or parts
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur li jindika ammont immultiplikat b'erba' jew għamla b'erba' naħat indaqs.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kamra kienet ta' daqs mrabba' perfettament.
usage_examples.en: The room was of perfectly squared dimensions.

definitions.text_en: four each, by fours (distributive numeral)
definitions.text_mt: Numru distributtiv li jindika tqassim jew għadd ta' erbgħa erbgħa f'daqqa.

usage_examples.mt: Qassmu t-tuffieħ rbiegħ lit-tfal fil-klassi.
usage_examples.en: They distributed the apples four each to the children in class.

definitions.text_en: fifth (ordinal numeral); coming next after the fourth in order or series
definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni li tiġi minnufih wara r-raba' f'ordni, grad jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Kien il-ħames parteċipant li lesta t-tellieqa sal-aħħar.
usage_examples.en: He was the fifth participant who completed the race to the end.

definitions.text_en: sixth (ordinal numeral); coming next after the fifth in order or series
definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni li tiġi minnufih wara l-ħames f'ordni, grad jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kapitlu sitt jispjega l-iżvilupp ewlieni tal-ġrajja.
usage_examples.en: Chapter six explains the main development of the event.

definitions.text_en: sixth (fraction of one sixth); one of six equal parts of a whole
definitions.text_mt: Frazzjoni li tindika parti waħda minn sitt partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa sest biss mill-art li kienet tmiss lilu b'wirt.
usage_examples.en: He took only a sixth of the land that belonged to him by inheritance.

definitions.text_en: sixfold, sextuple; six times as great in quantity or number
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur li jindika ammont sitt darbiet akbar minn dak ordinarju.

usage_examples.mt: In-nefqa kienet sestupla meta mqabbla mal-istima oriġinali.
usage_examples.en: The expense was sixfold when compared to the original estimate.

definitions.text_en: six each, by sixes (distributive numeral)
definitions.text_mt: Numru distributtiv li jindika tqassim jew għadd ta' sitta sitta f'daqqa.

usage_examples.mt: L-artisti daħlu stiet fuq il-palk quddiem l-udjenza.
usage_examples.en: The performers entered six each onto the stage in front of the audience.

definitions.text_en: eighth (ordinal numeral); coming next after the seventh in order or series
definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni li tiġi minnufih wara s-seba' f'ordni, grad jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Fit-tmien jum tal-vjaġġ waslu fl-aħħar port.
usage_examples.en: On the eighth day of the voyage they arrived at the final port.

definitions.text_en: eighth (Semitic fraction of one eighth); traditional eighth measure of capacity or land
definitions.text_mt: Frazzjoni Semitika li tindika parti waħda minn tmien partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa jew qjies tradizzjonali.

usage_examples.mt: Biegħ tomon żejt skont il-kejl antik tas-suq.
usage_examples.en: He sold an eighth of oil according to the ancient market measure.

definitions.text_en: eighth (fraction of one eighth); one of eight equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Frazzjoni li tindika parti waħda minn tmien partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: L-art kienet imqassma f'ottavi ndaqs bejn l-aħwa.
usage_examples.en: The land was divided into equal eighths between the siblings.

definitions.text_en: eightfold, octuple; eight times as great in number or quantity
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur li jindika ammont tmien darbiet akbar minn dak ordinarju.

usage_examples.mt: Ksibna riżultat ottuplu grazzi għall-effiċjenza tat-teknoloġija ġdida.
usage_examples.en: We achieved an eightfold result thanks to the efficiency of the new technology.
